edition: Hebrew–English column (Literal-Smooth, Rabbinic Priority) of the Saints.Bible Parallel Reader
source_hebrew: Westminster Leningrad Codex (pointed text via Sefaria), supplied for reference; the site does not display the Hebrew

verses.english: An oracle concerning Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
verses.hebrew: מַשָּׂא נִינְוֵה סֵפֶר חֲזוֹן נַחוּם הָאֶלְקֹשִׁי׃

verses.english: YHWH is a jealous and avenging God; YHWH avenges and is master of wrath. YHWH avenges His adversaries, and He reserves wrath for His enemies.
verses.hebrew: אֵל קַנּוֹא וְנֹקֵם יְהוָה נֹקֵם יְהוָה וּבַעַל חֵמָה נֹקֵם יְהוָה לְצָרָיו וְנוֹטֵר הוּא לְאֹיְבָיו׃

verses.english: YHWH is slow to anger and great in power, yet He certainly will not acquit. YHWH's way is in whirlwind and storm; clouds are the dust of His feet.
verses.hebrew: יְהֹוָה אֶרֶךְ אַפַּיִם וגדול־[וּגְדָל־] כֹּחַ וְנַקֵּה לֹא יְנַקֶּה יְהוָה בְּסוּפָה וּבִשְׂעָרָה דַּרְכּוֹ וְעָנָן אֲבַק רַגְלָיו׃

verses.english: He rebukes the sea and dries it up; He makes all the rivers dry. Bashan and Carmel wither, and Lebanon's blossom withers.
verses.hebrew: גּוֹעֵר בַּיָּם וַיַּבְּשֵׁהוּ וְכָל־הַנְּהָרוֹת הֶחֱרִיב אֻמְלַל בָּשָׁן וְכַרְמֶל וּפֶרַח לְבָנוֹן אֻמְלָל׃

verses.english: Mountains quake before Him and hills melt; the earth heaves before Him, the world and all who dwell in it.
verses.hebrew: הָרִים רָעֲשׁוּ מִמֶּנּוּ וְהַגְּבָעוֹת הִתְמֹגָגוּ וַתִּשָּׂא הָאָרֶץ מִפָּנָיו וְתֵבֵל וְכָל־יֹשְׁבֵי בָהּ׃

verses.english: Who can stand before His indignation? Who can rise before His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire, and rocks are shattered before Him.
verses.hebrew: לִפְנֵי זַעְמוֹ מִי יַעֲמוֹד וּמִי יָקוּם בַּחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ חֲמָתוֹ נִתְּכָה כָאֵשׁ וְהַצֻּרִים נִתְּצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ׃

verses.english: YHWH is good, a stronghold on a day of distress; He knows those who take refuge in Him.
verses.hebrew: טוֹב יְהוָה לְמָעוֹז בְּיוֹם צָרָה וְיֹדֵעַ חֹסֵי בוֹ׃

verses.english: With an overwhelming flood He will make a complete end of her place, and darkness will pursue His enemies.
verses.hebrew: וּבְשֶׁטֶף עֹבֵר כָּלָה יַעֲשֶׂה מְקוֹמָהּ וְאֹיְבָיו יְרַדֶּף־חֹשֶׁךְ׃

verses.english: What do you devise against YHWH? He is making a complete end; distress will not rise twice.
verses.hebrew: מַה־תְּחַשְּׁבוּן אֶל־יְהוָה כָּלָה הוּא עֹשֶׂה לֹא־תָקוּם פַּעֲמַיִם צָרָה׃

verses.english: Though they are like tangled thorns and drunk with their drink, they will be consumed like fully dry stubble.
verses.hebrew: כִּי עַד־סִירִים סְבֻכִים וּכְסָבְאָם סְבוּאִים אֻכְּלוּ כְּקַשׁ יָבֵשׁ מָלֵא׃

verses.english: From you came one devising evil against YHWH, a counselor of wickedness.
verses.hebrew: מִמֵּךְ יָצָא חֹשֵׁב עַל־יְהוָה רָעָה יֹעֵץ בְּלִיָּעַל׃

verses.english: Thus says YHWH: Though they are intact and numerous, even so they will be cut down and he will pass away. Though I afflicted you, I will afflict you no more.
verses.hebrew: כֹּה אָמַר יְהוָה אִם־שְׁלֵמִים וְכֵן רַבִּים וְכֵן נָגֹזּוּ וְעָבָר וְעִנִּתִךְ לֹא אֲעַנֵּךְ עוֹד׃

verses.english: And now I will break his yoke from upon you and tear apart your bonds.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֶשְׁבֹּר מֹטֵהוּ מֵעָלָיִךְ וּמוֹסְרֹתַיִךְ אֲנַתֵּק׃

verses.english: YHWH has commanded concerning you: No more of your name will be sown. From the house of your god I will cut off carved and cast images. I will make your grave, for you are contemptible.
verses.hebrew: וְצִוָּה עָלֶיךָ יְהוָה לֹא־יִזָּרַע מִשִּׁמְךָ עוֹד מִבֵּית אֱלֹהֶיךָ אַכְרִית פֶּסֶל וּמַסֵּכָה אָשִׂים קִבְרֶךָ כִּי קַלּוֹתָ׃

verses.english: Look, upon the mountains are the feet of one bringing good news, announcing peace! Celebrate your feasts, Judah; fulfill your vows. For the wicked one will never again pass through you; he is entirely cut off.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עַל־הֶהָרִים רַגְלֵי מְבַשֵּׂר מַשְׁמִיעַ שָׁלוֹם חָגִּי יְהוּדָה חַגַּיִךְ שַׁלְּמִי נְדָרָיִךְ כִּי לֹא יוֹסִיף עוֹד לעבור־[לַעֲבָר־] בָּךְ בְּלִיַּעַל כֻּלֹּה נִכְרָת׃

verses.english: A scatterer has come up against you. Guard the fortress; watch the road; brace your waist; greatly strengthen your might.
verses.hebrew: עָלָה מֵפִיץ עַל־פָּנַיִךְ נָצוֹר מְצֻרָה צַפֵּה־דֶרֶךְ חַזֵּק מָתְנַיִם אַמֵּץ כֹּחַ מְאֹד׃

verses.english: For YHWH is restoring Jacob's majesty, like Israel's majesty; for ravagers ravaged them and ruined their vine branches.
verses.hebrew: כִּי שָׁב יְהוָה אֶת־גְּאוֹן יַעֲקֹב כִּגְאוֹן יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי בְקָקוּם בֹּקְקִים וּזְמֹרֵיהֶם שִׁחֵתוּ׃

verses.english: His warriors' shields are reddened; the soldiers are clothed in scarlet. The chariots flash with fiery metal on the day of his preparation, and the cypress spears are brandished.
verses.hebrew: מָגֵן גִּבֹּרֵיהוּ מְאָדָּם אַנְשֵׁי־חַיִל מְתֻלָּעִים בְּאֵשׁ־פְּלָדוֹת הָרֶכֶב בְּיוֹם הֲכִינוֹ וְהַבְּרֹשִׁים הָרְעָלוּ׃

verses.english: Chariots race wildly in the streets, rushing about in the squares. Their appearance is like torches; they dart like lightning.
verses.hebrew: בַּחוּצוֹת יִתְהוֹלְלוּ הָרֶכֶב יִשְׁתַּקְשְׁקוּן בָּרְחֹבוֹת מַרְאֵיהֶן כַּלַּפִּידִם כַּבְּרָקִים יְרוֹצֵצוּ׃

verses.english: He recalls his nobles; they stumble as they go. They hurry to her wall, and the protective screen is prepared.
verses.hebrew: יִזְכֹּר אַדִּירָיו יִכָּשְׁלוּ בהלכותם [בַּהֲלִיכָתָם] יְמַהֲרוּ חוֹמָתָהּ וְהֻכַן הַסֹּכֵךְ׃

verses.english: The river gates are opened, and the palace melts away.
verses.hebrew: שַׁעֲרֵי הַנְּהָרוֹת נִפְתָּחוּ וְהַהֵיכָל נָמוֹג׃

verses.english: It is decreed: she is stripped and led away, her slave women moaning like the sound of doves, beating upon their breasts.
verses.hebrew: וְהֻצַּב גֻּלְּתָה הֹעֲלָתָה וְאַמְהֹתֶיהָ מְנַהֲגוֹת כְּקוֹל יוֹנִים מְתֹפְפֹת עַל־לִבְבֵהֶן׃

verses.english: Nineveh has been like a pool of water since her earliest days, yet they are fleeing. “Stop! Stop!” But no one turns back.
verses.hebrew: וְנִינְוֵה כִבְרֵכַת־מַיִם מִימֵי הִיא וְהֵמָּה נָסִים עִמְדוּ עֲמֹדוּ וְאֵין מַפְנֶה׃

verses.english: Plunder silver! Plunder gold! There is no end to the stored wealth, an abundance of every precious vessel.
verses.hebrew: בֹּזּוּ כֶסֶף בֹּזּוּ זָהָב וְאֵין קֵצֶה לַתְּכוּנָה כָּבֹד מִכֹּל כְּלִי חֶמְדָּה׃

verses.english: Emptiness, desolation and devastation! Hearts melt, knees give way, all waists tremble, and every face gathers pallor.
verses.hebrew: בּוּקָה וּמְבוּקָה וּמְבֻלָּקָה וְלֵב נָמֵס וּפִק בִּרְכַּיִם וְחַלְחָלָה בְּכָל־מָתְנַיִם וּפְנֵי כֻלָּם קִבְּצוּ פָארוּר׃

verses.english: Where is the lions' dwelling and the feeding place of young lions, where lion and lioness went, and the lion's cub, with no one frightening them?
verses.hebrew: אַיֵּה מְעוֹן אֲרָיוֹת וּמִרְעֶה הוּא לַכְּפִרִים אֲשֶׁר הָלַךְ אַרְיֵה לָבִיא שָׁם גּוּר אַרְיֵה וְאֵין מַחֲרִיד׃

verses.english: The lion tore enough for his cubs and strangled prey for his lionesses; he filled his dens with prey and his dwellings with torn flesh.
verses.hebrew: אַרְיֵה טֹרֵף בְּדֵי גֹרוֹתָיו וּמְחַנֵּק לְלִבְאֹתָיו וַיְמַלֵּא־טֶרֶף חֹרָיו וּמְעֹנֹתָיו טְרֵפָה׃

verses.english: Look, I am against you, declares YHWH of hosts. I will burn her chariots into smoke; the sword will consume your young lions. I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers will be heard no more.
verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי אֵלַיִךְ נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת וְהִבְעַרְתִּי בֶעָשָׁן רִכְבָּהּ וּכְפִירַיִךְ תֹּאכַל חָרֶב וְהִכְרַתִּי מֵאֶרֶץ טַרְפֵּךְ וְלֹא־יִשָּׁמַע עוֹד קוֹל מַלְאָכֵכֵה׃

verses.english: Woe to the city of bloodshed, wholly filled with lies and plunder! Prey never departs.
verses.hebrew: הוֹי עִיר דָּמִים כֻּלָּהּ כַּחַשׁ פֶּרֶק מְלֵאָה לֹא יָמִישׁ טָרֶף׃

verses.english: The sound of the whip, the sound of rattling wheels, galloping horse and bounding chariot!
verses.hebrew: קוֹל שׁוֹט וְקוֹל רַעַשׁ אוֹפָן וְסוּס דֹּהֵר וּמֶרְכָּבָה מְרַקֵּדָה׃

verses.english: Horsemen charging, flashing sword and glittering spear! Many slain, heaps of corpses, no end to the bodies; they stumble over their bodies.
verses.hebrew: פָּרָשׁ מַעֲלֶה וְלַהַב חֶרֶב וּבְרַק חֲנִית וְרֹב חָלָל וְכֹבֶד פָּגֶר וְאֵין קֵצֶה לַגְּוִיָּה יכשלו [וְכָשְׁלוּ] בִּגְוִיָּתָם׃

verses.english: Because of the many prostitutions of the prostitute, beautiful in charm, mistress of sorceries, who sells nations through her prostitutions and clans through her sorceries.
verses.hebrew: מֵרֹב זְנוּנֵי זוֹנָה טוֹבַת חֵן בַּעֲלַת כְּשָׁפִים הַמֹּכֶרֶת גּוֹיִם בִּזְנוּנֶיהָ וּמִשְׁפָּחוֹת בִּכְשָׁפֶיהָ׃

verses.english: Look, I am against you, declares YHWH of hosts. I will lift your skirts over your face and show nations your nakedness and kingdoms your disgrace.
verses.hebrew: הִנְנִי אֵלַיִךְ נְאֻם יְהוָה צְבָאוֹת וְגִלֵּיתִי שׁוּלַיִךְ עַל־פָּנָיִךְ וְהַרְאֵיתִי גוֹיִם מַעְרֵךְ וּמַמְלָכוֹת קְלוֹנֵךְ׃

verses.english: I will throw filth upon you, disgrace you and make you a spectacle.
verses.hebrew: וְהִשְׁלַכְתִּי עָלַיִךְ שִׁקֻּצִים וְנִבַּלְתִּיךְ וְשַׂמְתִּיךְ כְּרֹאִי׃

verses.english: Everyone who sees you will flee from you and say, “Nineveh is devastated! Who will mourn for her? Where shall I seek comforters for you?”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה כָל־רֹאַיִךְ יִדּוֹד מִמֵּךְ וְאָמַר שָׁדְּדָה נִינְוֵה מִי יָנוּד לָהּ מֵאַיִן אֲבַקֵּשׁ מְנַחֲמִים לָךְ׃

verses.english: Are you better than No-Amon, who sat among the Nile channels, water around her, whose rampart was the sea and whose wall was the sea?
verses.hebrew: הֲתֵיטְבִי מִנֹּא אָמוֹן הַיֹּשְׁבָה בַּיְאֹרִים מַיִם סָבִיב לָהּ אֲשֶׁר־חֵיל יָם מִיָּם חוֹמָתָהּ׃

verses.english: Cush was her strength, and Egypt, without limit; Put and the Libyans were your helpers.
verses.hebrew: כּוּשׁ עָצְמָה וּמִצְרַיִם וְאֵין קֵצֶה פּוּט וְלוּבִים הָיוּ בְּעֶזְרָתֵךְ׃

verses.english: Yet she too went into exile, into captivity. Her little ones were dashed to pieces at the head of every street; they cast lots for her honored ones, and all her great men were bound in chains.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־הִיא לַגֹּלָה הָלְכָה בַשֶּׁבִי גַּם עֹלָלֶיהָ יְרֻטְּשׁוּ בְּרֹאשׁ כָּל־חוּצוֹת וְעַל־נִכְבַּדֶּיהָ יַדּוּ גוֹרָל וְכָל־גְּדוֹלֶיהָ רֻתְּקוּ בַזִּקִּים׃

verses.english: You too will become drunk; you will be hidden. You too will seek refuge from the enemy.
verses.hebrew: גַּם־אַתְּ תִּשְׁכְּרִי תְּהִי נַעֲלָמָה גַּם־אַתְּ תְּבַקְשִׁי מָעוֹז מֵאוֹיֵב׃

verses.english: All your fortresses are fig trees with early fruit; if shaken, they fall into the eater's mouth.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־מִבְצָרַיִךְ תְּאֵנִים עִם־בִּכּוּרִים אִם־יִנּוֹעוּ וְנָפְלוּ עַל־פִּי אוֹכֵל׃

verses.english: Look, your people within you are women! The gates of your land are opened wide to your enemies; fire has consumed your bars.
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה עַמֵּךְ נָשִׁים בְּקִרְבֵּךְ לְאֹיְבַיִךְ פָּתוֹחַ נִפְתְּחוּ שַׁעֲרֵי אַרְצֵךְ אָכְלָה אֵשׁ בְּרִיחָיִך׃

verses.english: Draw water for the siege; strengthen your fortresses. Go into the mud, tread the clay, take hold of the brick mold.
verses.hebrew: מֵי מָצוֹר שַׁאֲבִי־לָךְ חַזְּקִי מִבְצָרָיִךְ בֹּאִי בַטִּיט וְרִמְסִי בַחֹמֶר הַחֲזִיקִי מַלְבֵּן׃

verses.english: There fire will consume you; a sword will cut you off, devouring you like the locust. Multiply yourself like the locust; multiply yourself like the swarm.
verses.hebrew: שָׁם תֹּאכְלֵךְ אֵשׁ תַּכְרִיתֵךְ חֶרֶב תֹּאכְלֵךְ כַּיָּלֶק הִתְכַּבֵּד כַּיֶּלֶק הִתְכַּבְּדִי כָּאַרְבֶּה׃

verses.english: You multiplied your merchants beyond the stars of heaven. The locust strips and flies away.
verses.hebrew: הִרְבֵּית רֹכְלַיִךְ מִכּוֹכְבֵי הַשָּׁמָיִם יֶלֶק פָּשַׁט וַיָּעֹף׃

verses.english: Your officials are like locusts, your marshals like a swarm of locusts settling on fences on a cold day. The sun rises, they fly away, and their place is unknown—where are they?
verses.hebrew: מִנְּזָרַיִךְ כָּאַרְבֶּה וְטַפְסְרַיִךְ כְּגוֹב גֹּבָי הַחוֹנִים בַּגְּדֵרוֹת בְּיוֹם קָרָה שֶׁמֶשׁ זָרְחָה וְנוֹדַד וְלֹא־נוֹדַע מְקוֹמוֹ אַיָּם׃

verses.english: Your shepherds slumber, king of Assyria; your nobles lie still. Your people are scattered upon the mountains, and no one gathers them.
verses.hebrew: נָמוּ רֹעֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר יִשְׁכְּנוּ אַדִּירֶיךָ נָפֹשׁוּ עַמְּךָ עַל־הֶהָרִים וְאֵין מְקַבֵּץ׃

verses.english: There is no easing of your fracture; your wound is grievous. All who hear the news of you clap their hands over you, for upon whom has your evil not continually passed?
verses.hebrew: אֵין־כֵּהָה לְשִׁבְרֶךָ נַחְלָה מַכָּתֶךָ כֹּל שֹׁמְעֵי שִׁמְעֲךָ תָּקְעוּ כַף עָלֶיךָ כִּי עַל־מִי לֹא־עָבְרָה רָעָתְךָ תָּמִיד׃
